# Sunofriend

> Sunofriend is a local-first, MacBook-tested alpha. On Apple-silicon macOS its public experimental separator defaults to broad vocals and complementary instrumental. Its installed, hash-pinned SCNet-large profile adds an explicit public opt-in vocals/drums/bass/grouped-other preview. Six-role synth-and-guitar work remains private, unregistered research and does not expand public support. It also prepares existing stems, then turns useful canonical WAV parts into editable MIDI, a balanced MIDI-derived song-interpretation WAV and a starter ZIP. Automatic results remain explicitly unreviewed; Studio preserves candidates for explicit listening and choice.

Sunofriend is an independent Unsigned Media Ltd project. Its name begins with the Hindi सुनो ("listen"). It is not related to or affiliated with Suno Inc.

## Best agent entry point

- Agent portability: the skill is not tied to Codex. It should be usable by skills-aware local coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity. Use the agent's native skill mechanism or give it the complete SKILL.md directly.
- Test boundary: macOS remains supported. A native Windows 11 x64 trial verified dependency installation, offline conversion/preview doctors and FFmpeg/FFprobe discovery. The feature branch now also passes native source-lineage locking and one `listen` publication path; complete demo/create, Studio and TUI journeys remain unqualified. Linux and Windows Subsystem for Linux are unverified. Feedback from every user is welcome through the existing compatibility report below.

## Newcomer protocol

1. Be honest about execution: hands-on setup requires a coding agent with local workspace and command access. A standard ChatGPT conversation can explain steps but cannot claim to install software or inspect local files.
2. Install and read the official Sunofriend skill first using the agent's native skill mechanism. In Codex, use `$skill-installer`. Do not install the app or audio dependencies in that turn. Confirm the skill is available, then stop.
3. In a second turn, explicitly use the installed skill. In Codex, invoke `$sunofriend`. Inspect what is already available and explain every proposed change.
4. For a new app checkout, use the skill's two-stage bootstrap: ask before preparing source only; rerun the plan and show the exact 40-character commit; then ask separately before applying that same commit. Apply must not fetch or switch it.
5. Offer exactly four friendly routes: experimentally separate one authorised finished song locally on a supported Apple-silicon Mac; use existing authorised separated audio parts; help exporting or obtaining authorised stems; or run the built-in copyright-safe synthetic demo.
6. The separation alpha is a separate opt-in route with a separately approved model/runtime. Plan setup with `scripts/setup-separation-alpha-macos.sh --plan`, verify with `sunofriend-separate doctor`, and plan a song with `sunofriend-separate separate SONG --out FRESH --rights-category owned`. Execute only after explicit rights confirmation and listen before any later MIDI conversion.
7. For agent-led work with stems, use `sunofriend create PROJECT --out-dir FRESH`. With no stems, use `sunofriend demo --out-dir FRESH`. When the person operates the TUI, prefer Simple / Make my song. These routes use only each exact published production primary and record no human preference.
8. Require a fresh output path. Keep automatic output labelled unreviewed and review recommended.
9. Use Studio only when the musician wants multiple-method comparison, explicit choices, feedback or a reviewed GarageBand handoff.

## Inputs

- One local folder containing synchronized top-level WAV stems for one song, or 2–64 already-separated supported audio parts that the folder importer can prepare first.
- A stem is a synchronized grouped submix, not necessarily one instrument. A drums stem can contain kick, snare, hats, toms, cymbals and percussion.
- An AI-separated stem is an estimate of a musical category, not the lost original studio track.
- Key, BPM and tuning in the folder name are strongly preferred.
- Optional local chord PDF.
- Music the user owns or is authorised to process.

Sunofriend never downloads streaming audio or infers processing permission from a public URL. Its default separator is an experimental local two-stem estimate; the explicit SCNet core-four opt-in preview is also not exact multitrack recovery.

## Experimental finished-mix separation

- Public default lane: broad `vocals`, complementary `instrumental` and a reconstruction check from one authorised finished mix on Apple-silicon macOS.
- Public explicit opt-in lane: installed profile `scnet-large-musdb-release-v1` in scope `core-four-stems-v1` estimates `vocals`, `drums`, `bass` and `grouped_other`. Its pinned checkpoint, offline synthetic check, three authorised full-song canaries and repeat resource runs passed the objective gates. Complete listens reported no catastrophic defect. This is estimated grouping, not recovered studio multitracks.
- Private unregistered research lane: SCNet core four plus Mega-53 synth and BS-RoFormer-SW guitar specialists produced private six-role reviews for `vocals`, `drums`, `bass`, `synth`, `guitar` and `residual_other`. These profiles are unregistered and there is no public six-role execution or activation.
- Private model-free recovery lane: status `private_review_package_recovered_model_free_resource_gate_incomplete`. The consumed original plan is SHA-256 `869ac229d5c95c9c3d5eb2c9eb38da368056f6fe3c644de9830cc593313efb7d`; the recovery request is `686a47f09b2f2e95a670e621aa75582e27bb14cebc64035f5c56af3c77f3e60c` and its report is `42500c2e9542aee5fc0e238697733923586ad1e37c54b1359a496cf832f330a0`. The historical replacement completed 3 model loads and 9 per-profile/song inference attempts but persisted no guitar worker result receipt, guard counters or peak-memory evidence. The network-denied recovery read 21 retained private audio payloads and wrote 24 PCM24 artifacts with 0 checkpoint loads, 0 model constructions, 0 model loads, 0 inference attempts, 0 canonicalisations, 0 model-worker subprocesses and 0 network attempts; one parent sandbox re-exec provided security supervision. Reconstruction is within 0 LSB, but guitar and full resource gates remain incomplete, `within_known_ceilings` is unknown and full objective qualification is false. The bound review is complete with status `human_listening_complete_no_selection` and document SHA-256 `093347845c41bb0c456a10564701961c627fea5737486a901627b0c4f5208a86`: all 3/3 songs were useful and non-catastrophic; core roles were useful in 3/3; synth and guitar were each useful in 2/2 confirmed-present cases; no scored role reported bleed, artefacts or timing/join problems; and each specialist reported some missing content in both scored cases. There were no cannot-tell or not-tested ratings. The immutable private outcome records that aggregate under status `private_full_song_six_role_listening_evidence_recorded_resource_gate_incomplete`, canonical document SHA-256 `fa5d1d24627dce4cb1e27175055f1e3d5a3a70683b98e2376d92ee125bc2163c`. This positive private musical result grants no automatic retry, public activation, source selection, MIDI, hosting, redistribution, audio upload or model download and does not repair objective/resource qualification.
- It is a separate `sunofriend-separate` command, not a Simple/TUI default, and the website never receives audio.
- The pinned public model/runtime is a separate explicit download. Plan without changes using `scripts/setup-separation-alpha-macos.sh --plan`; then accept the displayed model terms before installation.
- `sunofriend-separate doctor` is read-only: it hashes the exact local public profile without loading a model or processing audio. `sunofriend-separate profiles --json` reports immutable profile identities and status.
- Plan one song with `sunofriend-separate separate SONG --out FRESH --rights-category owned`. Add `--execute --confirm-rights --open-review` only after checking the plan.
- Automated checks cover file integrity, audio geometry, reconstruction accounting and reproducibility. Human listening decides usefulness, bleed, missing sound, texture and joins.
- Reuse the existing compatibility report with Copy text-only feedback. Do not attach stems, vocals, private music, review JSON, filenames or metadata. Poor musical feedback cannot disable the last functioning profile.
- Canonical guide: https://github.com/N9-Developer-Empowerment/sunofriend/blob/main/docs/STEM_SEPARATION_ALPHA.md
- Full-stem engineering plan: https://github.com/N9-Developer-Empowerment/sunofriend/blob/main/docs/FULL_STEM_SEPARATION_PLAN.md
- Canonical public/private status: https://sunofriend.com/research/separation/
- Feedback may improve instructions, portability and the next bounded experiment. It never selects a model or musical default automatically.

## Reference-conditioned song generation

- `sunofriend song-providers` prints a secret-free provider capability registry without network access. An evaluated provider is not necessarily registered for the current operation.
- `sunofriend song-generate REFERENCE --lyrics LYRICS --style DESCRIPTION --reference-strength 0.5 --style-strength 0.5 --out-dir FRESH` creates a read-only, hash-bound plan by default.
- The request uses one authorised reference song or excerpt, an exact annotated lyric sheet, a descriptive style prompt and two independent 0–1 strength controls.
- Add `--execute --confirm-rights` only after reviewing the plan and affirming private personal processing authority.
- One execution requests exactly two complete listener-ready mixed songs. The model chooses song duration from the lyrics, style and arrangement; Sunofriend does not select a winner or create stems or MIDI in this step.
- The first adapter targets an already running ACE-Step API with a Base model. It passes the reference by a shared local filesystem path, maps reference strength to audio-cover strength and style strength to guidance scale, and records the mapping, output hashes and available seeds in durable receipts.
- TREBLO Melodia v3 is documented as an optional proprietary BYO-key cloud provider but is not registered for this reference-conditioned operation: v3 accepts prompt and lyrics, while source audio is continuation-only and there is no independent reference-strength control. Never silently discard the reference, incur charges, upload audio or expose a key to browser JavaScript.
- Any future cloud adapter requires explicit provider selection, terms/privacy/cost acknowledgement, a user-owned environment key, required attribution and immediate local archiving of expiring results. Provider policy: https://github.com/N9-Developer-Empowerment/sunofriend/blob/main/docs/SONG_GENERATION_PROVIDERS.md
- The command does not install or start a model service. The website does not accept audio. Backend availability, model quality and the first human listening acceptance demonstration remain empirical work.
- Product contract: https://github.com/N9-Developer-Empowerment/sunofriend/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE_CONDITIONED_SONG_GENERATION_SPEC.md

## Vocal comping research

- Status: private phrase-level pilot; whole-song browser workflow is being designed. It is not a public product route.
- Goal: lyric-aware, melody-aware vocal comping from the singer's own synchronized takes, with human-reviewed phrase choices, natural assembly and optional gentle correction.
- Working private scope: reviewed phrase playback, aligned browser pickup recording, target-relative evidence and explicit listening feedback.
- Current non-capabilities: no automatic take selection, phrase joining, finished comp rendering, pitch correction, AI voice generation, website recording or audio upload.
- Known lyrics remain canonical. Local speech transcription is rough phonetic/timing evidence only and cannot silently rewrite words.
- MIDI is only the melodic skeleton. Breath, diction, tone, expression, timbre continuity and safe edit boundaries require separate evidence and human listening.
- Recommended whole-song direction: retain one broad human base performance, then use a low-stress browser loop for focused phrase pickups; review transitions before any optional correction.
- Use phrases or lines as the default edit unit. Word or syllable substitutions are rescue edits only after their boundaries are explicitly reviewed.
- Canonical status and GUI concept: https://sunofriend.com/research/vocal-comping/

### Source preparation

- `sunofriend source-doctor` checks the existing local FFmpeg and FFprobe import toolchain without writing files.
- `sunofriend source-import-folder SOURCE_FOLDER --out-dir FRESH --rights-category CATEGORY --plan` inspects 2–64 already-separated top-level supported assets without writing.
- Review inferred roles, recorded-origin status, warnings and outputs. A role map is a JSON file path whose flat object is keyed by exact filename.
- Execution removes `--plan`, replans current inputs and publishes immutable originals, canonical top-level PCM24 WAV stems, per-source and aggregate receipts, and a source-project manifest. Rerun the plan after any input, role-map or option change.
- Never silently add `--accept-unconfirmed-origin`: it acknowledges missing concrete origin evidence and does not prove alignment. A concrete origin conflict blocks execution.
- Folder import does not recurse, separate, shift, pad, stretch, normalize or align audio, prove a downbeat, or create MIDI. A prepared project is directly usable by Create or TUI.
- `pads` is not an accepted observed role because production currently synthesizes pads from keys. Use `strings` only for a genuinely string-like sustained part; otherwise leave it unresolved. Composite `drums` is preserved pending S2.
- `sunofriend source-import SOURCE --out-dir FRESH --plan` probes one authorised supported local audio asset and prints the exact read-only plan.
- After the plan is reviewed, the same command without `--plan` preserves an immutable copy of the original and creates a canonical PCM24 WAV, receipt and source-project manifest in a fresh folder.
- This is preparation of one asset, not a song-project importer. It does not align a folder, separate a finished mix, transcribe MIDI, or make a non-WAV project directly usable by create, Simple or Studio.

The public provider guide uses neutral ordinary links. Sunofriend currently
has no affiliate relationship with a listed provider and has not ranked one
as best for downstream MIDI. Before suggesting a cloud service, ask whether
the audio is unreleased, confidential or otherwise unsuitable for upload.

## Simple outputs

- individual editable MIDI files;
- a combined General MIDI proxy;
- a balanced MIDI-derived song-interpretation WAV;
- receipt, short start guide and starter ZIP.

The source stems provide timing, horizon and level evidence. They are not mixed into the interpretation WAV. The WAV is not exact waveform reconstruction and is not a human-approved release master.

## Current boundary

- local alpha supported on the documented macOS route;
- native Windows setup, offline diagnostics and one `listen` publication path are partially verified, but complete application journeys remain unqualified; Linux and Windows Subsystem for Linux remain unverified;
- preserve follow-up portability feedback so SKILL.md and setup guidance can improve;
- no stem upload or conversion endpoint on the public website;
- no vocal recording, vocal upload or automatic finished vocal comp on the public website;
- optional models and checkpoints require separate explicit approval;
- automatic output is not a human Workbench decision;
- process only authorised music.

The built-in demo creates copyright-safe synthetic stems and runs the normal automatic MIDI/WAV/ZIP pipeline after core setup. The page explains the command and includes a listening and worked-output tour; it does not host a pre-rendered demo download.
